question: In evidence.zip, Use the unique d27-- member whose basename ends nobanner.elf. Report the compiler version (dotted numeric, e.g. 12.2.1) named by the first-CU DW_AT_producer or the .comment compiler banner.

answer_format.syntax: exact case-sensitive artifact-derived text only; no quotes or explanatory text

generator_cmd: sh ta_gen.sh  # gcc -g | clang-18 -g -no-pie | gcc -static -s | aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc -g -static | zig cc -target x86_64-linux-musl | gcc + strip -s -R .comment; ta_d27_{gcc,tcc}.elf = D27 GM members verbatim
oracle_cmd: sh -c 'p=$(readelf --debug-dump=info ta_nobanner.elf 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 DW_AT_producer); [ -n "$p" ] || p=$(readelf -p .comment ta_nobanner.elf 2>/dev/null | grep -E "clang version" || readelf -p .comment ta_nobanner.elf 2>/dev/null | grep GCC:); echo "$p" | grep -oE "(GNU C[0-9+]* |clang version |\) )[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?" | head -1 | grep -oE "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$" || echo none'
